source.note: Wikipedia kits-table row for Famalicão: the kit-manufacturer cell (with a Germany flag) renders as 'Puma' and the main-sponsor cell as 'bwin'; Puma maker marks and authenticity patch are also visible on the club shop photos of the Camisola Principal 26/27 (opened 2026-09-28), and Puma is listed among the club's Premium Sponsors on fcfamalicao.pt/parceiros.

summary: Front bwin (three-season main-sponsor deal announced 19 August 2026, brand on the front of the first-team shirts plus naming of the Estádio Municipal's east stand); back Mercainox and Hyundai; sleeve Chanceplus; shorts Enif; kit made by Puma. Front and sleeve confirmed on the club shop's product photos; back and shorts per the Wikipedia kits table, with all five named partners on the club's own Parceiros page.
